PLAN "12-week Moderate Gym Fitness for 58yo Post-MI"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "general fitness and conditioning"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Adaptation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full body moderate":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12..15 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          plank 2x30..45 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walking 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Cardio + core":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          rowing 1x15..20 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x8..10 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          hamstring_stretch 2x30..30 rpe 5 rest 30 seconds
          crunch 3x12..15 rpe 6 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          cycling 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Upper focus":
        warmup:
          walking 8m
